overview: The commission introduced a new intern, consolidated its November and December meetings to December 4th, and began planning for a 2025 disability fair at the inclusive playground. Members also focused on election accessibility, planning to coordinate with the Elections Commission to verify that accessible voting machines are properly set up and staffed at polling locations.

items.title: Introductions and New Intern
items.summary: Commissioners introduced themselves and welcomed Nicholas Karenge as the new disability specialist intern for the Office of Diversity, Equity and Inclusion.

items.title: Schedule Changes and Recruitment
items.summary: The commission discussed recruitment challenges and approved moving the November meeting to December 4th as a combined session for the remainder of the year.

items.title: Disability Fair Planning
items.summary: Members discussed hosting a disability fair at the inclusive playground in April or May 2025, including a proposal for a donor-funded ice cream social.

items.title: Polling Place Accessibility
items.summary: The commission addressed concerns regarding the readiness of accessible voting machines at polling places and planned to coordinate site visits to verify machine setup and staff training.

items.title: Commission Ordinance Review
items.summary: The chair reviewed the commission's official powers and duties under the city ordinance to ensure equal status for persons with disabilities in the political sphere.
